page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.gn5 family. It runs on the KVM hypervisor and features an x86_64 architecture with 56 dedicated physical cores and 56 vCPUs, operating with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. The instance is equipped with 224.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

For acceleration, the server incorporates two NVIDIA P100 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 32 GB of VRAM. Local storage is bundled with the instance, consisting of a 944 GB SSD. Networking capabilities include a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this configuration.

Due to the inclusion of dual NVIDIA P100 GPUs alongside 56 dedicated cores, this instance is designed for workloads requiring parallel processing, such as deep learning training, GPU-accelerated database queries, and scientific simulations. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing power without resource contention, while the local SSD storage supports fast data access for active datasets.
